content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Start digital

Gumroad is a popular choice for digital creators, allowing you to sell products directly to consumers. However, it imposes a hefty 10% fee on every sale, which can quickly eat into profits, especially for creators selling at lower price points. In contrast, the COREMERCH Complete Builder Kit offers a comprehensive suite of tools designed for sovereign commerce, enabling creators to sell digital products without platform dependency. With a one-time fee of $197, it includes everything needed to set up an online store, automate deliveries, and process payments using NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5%. This means you retain more of your earnings and have full ownership of your digital storefront. Each option has its advantages, but the clear winner for creators looking to maximize their revenue is the COREMERCH approach.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

For creators in restricted countries, using platforms like Gumroad or PayPal can be a significant barrier due to the inability to access services. These platforms often block access based on geographical location, leaving creators without viable options to monetize their work. COREMERCH recognizes this gap and tailors its solutions accordingly. By leveraging blockchain technology and cryptocurrency, the Complete Builder Kit allows creators from regions like Zimbabwe, Pakistan, and Ethiopia to transact seamlessly. This infrastructure not only bypasses traditional banking restrictions but also empowers creators with full ownership of their sales process, ensuring they can operate independently without reliance on conventional financial systems.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing speed is critical for maintaining cash flow and customer satisfaction. Platforms like Gumroad may take a significant cut of your earnings, charging 10% per sale, which translates to $970 lost on 100 sales of a $97 product. In contrast, using NOWPayments with COREMERCH only incurs a 0.5% fee, resulting in a $921 retention increase under the same sales conditions. Additionally, while Gumroad can delay funds availability, NOWPayments offers immediate on-chain verification and instant payment processing through cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin, USDT, and others. This fundamentally alters the economic landscape for digital creators, allowing them to keep their hard-earned cash.
Now is the time to own your digital sales infrastructure.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the most significant advantages of using COREMERCH is complete ownership of your digital assets and sales. Unlike Gumroad, where you are essentially renting access to your storefront, COREMERCH provides the tools for full control over your online business. The Complete Builder Kit automates product delivery through platforms like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, ensuring that your customers receive their purchases instantly. This level of automation not only streamlines operations but also enhances customer satisfaction and reduces manual workload. In a world where digital creators are often at the mercy of platform policies, owning your infrastructure is a game-changer.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs as a creator. If your primary concern is low transaction fees and retaining maximum revenue, the COREMERCH Complete Builder Kit is the clear choice, especially for those in regions without reliable payment options. For creators looking for simplicity and ease of use, Gumroad may seem appealing; however, the long-term costs and restrictions could hinder growth. The Complete Builder Kit not only provides essential tools for selling but also equips you with the knowledge to scale your operations effectively without being shackled by platform limitations.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a solution like COREMERCH's Complete Builder Kit. This kit offers everything you need to sell digital products with cryptocurrency, bypassing traditional payment processors. You can automate the delivery of your products and enjoy low fees, ensuring more revenue stays in your pocket.
Stop paying high fees and regain control of your revenue.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I start selling digital products without platform fees?

You can start selling digital products by using the Complete Builder Kit from COREMERCH. This kit allows you to set up your own infrastructure to sell products directly to customers without incurring high platform fees.
What payment systems can I use instead of PayPal?
NOWPayments is a viable alternative that supports over 300 cryptocurrencies with low fees. This system allows you to accept payments without needing a traditional banking platform.
Is there a way to automate product delivery?
Yes, by using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, you can automate the delivery of digital products immediately after purchase, enhancing customer satisfaction.
How do I handle taxes on digital sales?

Handling taxes on digital sales can vary by location. Consult local regulations regarding digital goods sales. Ensure your infrastructure allows you to collect necessary taxes during the transaction if required.
Can I sell different types of digital products with COREMERCH?
Absolutely. COREMERCH's infrastructure supports a range of digital products, including ebooks, courses, software, templates, and more, giving you the flexibility to diversify your offerings.
